data.professional_title: RPA Developer | Power Platform Consultant | AI & Automation Specialist
data.summary:
Automation Developer with 4.5 years of experience delivering workflow automation, low-code applications, and RPA solutions using Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Power Apps, AI Builder, Copilot Studio and Blueprism. Strong expertise in building AI-driven Copilot Agents, agentic automations, scalable enterprise workflows, and integrating business systems to enhance operational efficiency.
SKILLS & TECHNOLOGIES
Automation: Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Blue Prism - Power Platform: Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Dataverse, SharePoint - AI & Copilot Automation: AI Builder, Copilot Agents, Agentic Flows - Data & Reporting: Excel automation, Power BI dashboards - Tools & Cloud: SAP, Jira, ServiceNow, Microsoft Visio, Microsoft Azure, AWS (Admin) - Soft Skills: Problem Solving, Communication, Team Leadership, Process Optimization

projects.name: Hyper Automation Solution – Power Apps + AI Builder + Power Automate:
projects.description:
Hyper Automation Solution – Power Apps + AI Builder + Power Automate:
Developed a canvas Power App for users to upload various types of KYC documents. - Built and integrated a document segregation AI Builder model triggered via Power Automate Cloud Flows. This
model classifies document types and routes them to appropriate AI Builder models trained on credit cards, 
The extracted data is stored in a CSV file, processed, and passed back to Power Apps for review and validation. - Created supporting Power Automate Desktop flows that access third-party applications like Omiga, TransUnion, and BMM to fetch customer verification data. This involved a maintenance module that resets application credentials, a loader to queue volumes, and a worker module to collect and store outputs in a formatted MI 
- Built a Power App integrated with SharePoint to manage incident reports for RPA bots. - The app captures details such as ticket ID, description, status, assigned team member, and comments. - Notifications are sent via Outlook to inform users about ticket updates, enabling efficient tracking and resolution
- Designed a Power Automate scheduled workflow that reads employee data from a SharePoint list to check for
 - - Updated request status after approval/rejection and sent confirmation notifications to employees.
Implemented manager approval logic with automated reminder emails for pending actions.
Automated Banking Applications – Power Automate Desktop (Migration) - Migrated Blue Prism bots to Power Automate Desktop to interact with web-based banking systems. 
- Data was formatted and consolidated into master Excel files for monthly reporting, saving the business 20 FTEs.
- Designed and implemented an intelligent Commercial Banking Assistant that responds to the underwriter queries
with provided knowledge sources. It provides information on financial analysis, Risk management, Credit 
- Upgraded Blue Prism from v6.10.3 to v6.10.5, enabling enhanced features and improved stability. - Migrated bots from Internet Explorer to Microsoft Edge due to deprecation, solving multiple UI spying
- Performed routine bot health checks, handled production issues, resolved exceptions, and implemented change
